headline: Indian Benchmark Indices End Marginally Lower in Muhurat Trading, Breaking Seven-Day Winning Streak

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower during the Muhurat trading session, pausing a seven-day rally.
Indian stocks broke an eight-year Diwali winning streak as benchmarks saw a slight decline.
Global factors and commodity price volatility are expected to influence market sentiment in Samvat 2083.
Investors are closely watching key macroeconomic developments and global cues for Monday trading action.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the special Muhurat trading session to mark the start of Samvat 2083.
Indian markets had previously registered their best weekly performance in six years, bucking a global tech rout.
Smaller capitalization stocks outperformed benchmark indices during the Diwali trading session.
Tata Motors continues to lead Mahindra & Mahindra in passenger vehicle market market share driven by strong EV sales.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices closed marginally lower during the Diwali Muhurat trading session, snapping a seven-day winning streak.
Despite the slight drop, Indian equities recently recorded their strongest weekly performance in six years.
Market participants are monitoring global commodity price volatility and key market triggers for the upcoming week.
